artifacts.minimum_depth: latest three annual periods and latest interim/quarterly disclosure, with reported versus forecast separation
artifacts.blocking_conditions: A reported or forecast denominator without period and source is S-level.

artifacts.minimum_depth: price, share count and market cap reconcile; price action has a benchmark context
all material filing, market, peer, broker and model inputs are registered
artifacts.blocking_conditions: An unregistered high-impact model claim is S-level.

artifacts.minimum_depth: all material customer, platform, order, ASP, margin and valuation claims are classified
artifacts.blocking_conditions: Unsupported customer, platform, order or ASP claims used in target-price math are S-level.

artifacts.minimum_depth: separates automotive monetised capability, commercialisation option and ecosystem option using issuer sources
artifacts.blocking_conditions: A cooperation, nomination, POC, product release or unspecified order used as revenue, margin or EPS is S-level.
artifacts.verifier_check: Physical AI claim and source linkage

artifacts.minimum_depth: separates high-level automotive AI, low-speed logistics and embodied intelligence paths
artifacts.blocking_conditions: Industry narrative without customer-to-cash conversion gates is S-level when used for valuation.
artifacts.verifier_check: Physical AI path and chain-economics review

artifacts.minimum_depth: original-PDF or broker-official rows show date, forecasts, target and method, or explicitly disclose field gaps
artifacts.blocking_conditions: Weak broker material with positive valuation weight is S-level.

artifacts.minimum_depth: cockpit, driving-domain and software profit pools connect operating evidence to valuation eligibility
artifacts.blocking_conditions: Auto-electronics demand narrative without revenue-to-margin conversion is S-level when used for valuation.

artifacts.minimum_depth: separate cockpit, driving-domain and software/service bridges with scenario sensitivities
artifacts.blocking_conditions: Unbridged platform migration or one-quarter annualisation is S-level.

artifacts.minimum_depth: uses evidence-gated sensitivities and does not make an unverified revenue forecast
artifacts.blocking_conditions: Sensitivity or subjective probability added to the base target before unit-economics evidence is S-level.
artifacts.verifier_check: Physical AI arithmetic and zero-base-credit review

artifacts.minimum_depth: explicitly separates the current-price target from 2026-2028 option research
artifacts.blocking_conditions: Base target and unverified option value mixed without disclosure is S-level.

artifacts.minimum_depth: business-model-matched valuation with comparable and multi-anchor cross-check
artifacts.blocking_conditions: A broker target used as house target, or unreproducible arithmetic, is S-level.

artifacts.minimum_depth: all published valuation outputs recompute from structured model
artifacts.blocking_conditions: Missing reproducibility pass or fake precision is S-level.

artifacts.minimum_depth: prose-led chapters and readable exhibits without workflow language in the body
artifacts.blocking_conditions: Table-only decision content, unsupported conclusion or rendering defect is S-level.

artifacts.minimum_depth: same-version evidence, model, PDF and R0-R4 closure are recorded
artifacts.blocking_conditions: PASS with material evidence or valuation conflict is S-level.
